Question:
Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
SELECT bb.striker, pm.team_id, m.match_winner, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE bs.match_id = 734010
GROUP BY bb.striker, pm.team_id, m.match_winner
ORDER BY total_runs DESC

[B]
SQL:
WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bb.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM player_runs pr
JOIN player_match pm ON pr.match_id = pm.match_id 
    AND pr.player_id = pm.player_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON pr.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner

WITH match_losing_team AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        CASE WHEN match_winner = team_1 THEN team_2 ELSE team_1 END AS losing_team_id
    FROM match
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
player_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.match_id,
        pm.player_id,
        pm.team_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN match_losing_team mlt ON pm.match_id = mlt.match_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON pm.match_id = bbb.match_id
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bbb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE pm.team_id = mlt.losing_team_id
      AND bs.runs_scored IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pm.match_id, pm.player_id, pm.team_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name,
    ptr.total_runs,
    m.team_1,
    m.team_2,
    m.match_winner,
    ptr.team_id AS player_team,
    CASE WHEN m.match_winner = m.team_1 THEN m.team_2 ELSE m.team_1 END AS losing_team
FROM player_total_runs ptr
JOIN player p ON ptr.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN match m ON ptr.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE ptr.total_runs >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name
